unmet_need: No intervention has been shown to recover lost lung function in humans; the best active arm still declines.
evidence_basis: Least-declining active arm reported: -21.5 mL/26 wk (ELEVATE-IPF, PMID 42085224). All phase 3 positive arms decline -43.3 to -138.6 mL/52 wk.

unmet_need: Reversal of established fibrosis has never been demonstrated, measured or defined as a human endpoint.
evidence_basis: No human trial endpoint for reversal in retrieved evidence; quantitative HRCT has no accepted MCID and is not a registration endpoint.
status: Gap; preclinical reports do not license human claims (L2)

unmet_need: No randomised evidence that any drug prolongs survival in IPF.
evidence_basis: Only RCT with mortality as primary endpoint was negative (INSPIRE, HR 1.15, 95% CI 0.77-1.71). Survival signals are observational: pooled RR 0.55 (0.45-0.66, I2=82%), registry HR 0.56 (0.34-0.92), causal-inference HR 0.53 (0.28-1.03).
status: Structurally unaddressed: mortality trials in mild-to-moderate IPF judged of prohibitive size, duration and cost (PMID 24476390)

unmet_need: No intervention has shown a dyspnoea or quality-of-life benefit exceeding the relevant MCID in a pivotal IPF trial.
evidence_basis: INSTAGE SGRQ -1.28 vs -0.36 (null, PMID 30220235); no positive HRQoL pivotal result retrieved.
status: Unaddressed; complicated by contested MCID thresholds

unmet_need: Cough has one small, short randomised positive result and no durable treatment.
evidence_basis: PACIFY COUGH: -39.4% awake cough frequency at day 14, n=44 (PMID 38237620); omeprazole pilot -39.1% with CI crossing null (PMID 30610155).
status: Partially addressed at 14 days; durability, generalisability and MCID all unknown

unmet_need: No adequately powered randomised evidence for preventing or treating acute exacerbations; the one randomised treatment attempt signalled harm.
evidence_basis: Pooled RR 0.63 (0.53-0.76) is predominantly observational (PMID 34217681); TETON-1/-2 exacerbation endpoints hierarchy-stopped; EXAFIP cyclophosphamide 3-month mortality 45% vs 31% (PMID 34506761).
status: Unaddressed; in-hospital mortality after an exacerbation remains ~29.5% (PMID 35614114)

unmet_need: Durability of antifibrotic effect beyond 52 weeks has never been randomised.
evidence_basis: Every pivotal trial for an approved or recently positive agent is <=52 weeks.
status: Unaddressed; extensions and real-world cohorts are not randomised comparisons

unmet_need: The field's own endpoint methodology is unresolved: incompatible FVC metrics, direction-dependent and disputed MCIDs, and no retrieved trial-level surrogacy validation.
evidence_basis: Four distinct FVC metrics across pivotal trials with ~3-fold variation in placebo-arm decline; K-BILD MID estimates differ 2-3 fold (PMID 23867809 vs 32316976); MCIDs re-estimated substantially higher by anchor-only methods (PMID 34671666); two literature searches for trial-level FVC-mortality surrogacy returned no validation study.
status: Unaddressed; this is a precondition for interpreting every other dimension

unmet_need: The randomised evidence base is concentrated in mild-to-moderate physiologic impairment; severe disease is under-represented.
evidence_basis: Mortality-rate analysis and MCID derivation both specify mild-to-moderate impairment (PMID 24476390; PMID 42548365); PACIFY COUGH mean FVC 82 %pred.
status: Unaddressed; effect estimates and MCIDs may not transfer across severity strata

unmet_need: Results of a large fraction of completed IPF trials cannot be found.
evidence_basis: Of 239 completed interventional IPF studies, 90 have posted results, 39 have a post-completion linked publication (primary outcome unverified) and 110 have neither; 97 of those (4,182 participants) completed more than 12 months ago. 21 of the 97 were phase 2 or 3.

unmet_need: No validated predictive biomarker identifies who benefits from which treatment; the one prospective genotype-selected trial has not reported.
evidence_basis: TOLLIP rs3750920 x NAC interaction is retrospective (PMID 26331942); PRECISIONS (NCT04300920, n=202) completed 2026-03-02 with no results posted and only a design paper indexed (PMID 36514019).
status: Open; PRECISIONS is within its 12-month reporting window as of 2026-09-02 (see corrections log)

unmet_need: Non-pharmacological and supportive care evidence is largely ILD-wide rather than IPF-specific.
evidence_basis: Cochrane pulmonary rehabilitation review covers interstitial lung disease broadly (PMID 34559419); no IPF-specific randomised oxygen trial was identified by this search.
status: Open; under L1 such evidence enters only as labelled indirect evidence
